description:
OPT/CPT/H4/L2/EAD/Citizen's are Welcome..!!


Required:


Associate's Degree/College Diploma

At least 2 years experience in developing mobile applications (native or hybrid), iOS/Android/Windows

At least 2 years experience in aspects of the mobile lifecycle 
including application development application structure, device and 
operation system Application Program Interface (API),debugging, 
performance,security and deployment

At least 2 years experience in one or more of the following - 
Asynchronous JavaScript and XML (Ajax), Representational State Transfer 
(REST), Javascript Object Notation (JSON)

At least 1 year experience in development role including SQL quieries and Stored Procedures

At least 1 year experience in integrating mobile applications with RESTful Web Services

At least 6 months experience in using version control systems, such as GIT

Basic knowledge in Core Date, Core Graphics, Core Anamation and/or OpenGL

Basic knowledge in Agile framework/process

Basic knowledge in Ruby, iOS User Interface (UI) design

Basic knowledge in iOX/Xcode/Swift

English: Basic knowledge.


 Skill :    iOS/Android/Windows


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
